questions.question:
Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
Hint: Excellence rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"

candidates.sql:
SELECT MAX(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)"::double precision / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"::double precision) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.numtsttakr > 0
  AND (s.numge1500::double precision / s.numtsttakr::double precision) > 0.3
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0

SELECT MAX(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)"::numeric / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.numtsttakr IS NOT NULL
  AND s.numge1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND (s.numge1500::numeric / NULLIF(s.numtsttakr, 0)) > 0.3
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL

SELECT MAX(fr."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)"::double precision / NULLIF(fr."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) AS max_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm fr ON s.cds = fr.cdscode
WHERE s.numtsttakr IS NOT NULL
  AND s.numtsttakr > 0
  AND s.numge1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND (s.numge1500::double precision / s.numtsttakr::double precision) > 0.3

questions.question:
List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.
Hint: Diffrence in enrollement = "Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", school name = "School"

candidates.sql:
SELECT fr."School Name" AS school_name,
       (s.street || ', ' || s.city || ', ' || s.state || ' ' || s.zip) AS full_address
FROM frpm fr
JOIN schools s
  ON fr.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE abs(fr."Enrollment (K-12)" - fr."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

SELECT s.school, (s.street || ', ' || s.city || ', ' || s.state || ' ' || s.zip) AS full_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE abs(COALESCE(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) - COALESCE(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) > 30

SELECT s.school AS school_name, (s.street || ', ' || s.city || ', ' || s.state || ' ' || s.zip) AS full_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE abs(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

SELECT COALESCE(s.school, f."School Name") AS school_name,
       (s."street" || ', ' || s."city" || ', ' || s."state" || ' ' || s."zip") AS full_street_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE ABS( (f."Enrollment (K-12)"::double precision) - (f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"::double precision) ) > 30

SELECT s.school, s.street || ', ' || s.city || ', ' || s.state || ' ' || s.zip AS full_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

SELECT s.school, (s.street || ', ' || s.city || ', ' || s.state || ' ' || s.zip) AS full_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL

questions.question:
Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K-12 is more than 0.1 and test takers whose test score is greater than or equal to 1500?
Hint: Percent eligible for free meals = Free Meal Count (K-12) / Total (Enrollment (K-12)

candidates.sql:
SELECT f."School Name"
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds
WHERE (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::double precision / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)"::double precision, 0)) > 0.1
AND s.numge1500 > 0

SELECT f."School Name" FROM frpm f JOIN satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") > 0.1 AND s.numge1500 >= 1 AND s.rtype = 'S'

SELECT DISTINCT f."School Name"
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds
WHERE (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) > 0.1
  AND s."numge1500" > 0
  AND s.rtype = 'S'

SELECT f."School Name"
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") > 0.1
  AND COALESCE(s.numge1500, 0) >= 1

questions.question:
Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT is greater than 400, along with the funding type of these schools?
Hint: Average of average math = sum(average math scores) / count(schools), in Riverside refers to "District Name" LIKE 'Riverside%'

candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.sname, sc.fundingtype
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE s.dname IN (
  SELECT s2.dname
  FROM satscores AS s2
  WHERE s2.dname LIKE 'Riverside%' AND s2.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s2.dname
  HAVING AVG(s2.avgscrmath) > 400
) AND s.rtype = 'S' AND s.sname IS NOT NULL AND s.sname = sc.school

SELECT s.sname, sch.fundingtype
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.sname = sch.school
WHERE s.dname LIKE 'Riverside%'
AND s.dname IN (
  SELECT s2.dname
  FROM satscores s2
  WHERE s2.dname LIKE 'Riverside%'
  GROUP BY s2.dname
  HAVING AVG(s2.avgscrmath) > 400
)

SELECT s.sname, sc.fundingtype
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.sname = sc.school
WHERE s.sname IS NOT NULL
  AND s.dname IN (
    SELECT s2.dname
    FROM satscores s2
    WHERE s2.dname LIKE 'Riverside%'
    GROUP BY s2.dname
    HAVING AVG(s2.avgscrmath) > 400
  )

SELECT DISTINCT sch.school, sch.fundingtype
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools sch ON ss.cds = sch.cdscode
WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND ss.dname LIKE 'Riverside%'
  AND (
    (SELECT AVG(sub.avgscrmath::numeric)
     FROM satscores sub
     WHERE sub.rtype = 'S' AND sub.dname LIKE 'Riverside%')
    > 400
  )

WITH district_avg AS (
  SELECT
    ss.dname,
    SUM(ss.avgscrmath)::float / COUNT(*) AS avg_math

questions.question:
Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT? Indicate their full names.
Hint: full name means first name, last name; There are at most 3 administrators for each school; SAT Scores are greater or equal to 1500 refers to NumGE1500

candidates.sql:
SELECT CONCAT(s.admfname1, ' ', s.admlname1) AS admin1_full, CONCAT(s.admfname2, ' ', s.admlname2) AS admin2_full, CONCAT(s.admfname3, ' ', s.admlname3) AS admin3_full
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE ss.numge1500 = (
  SELECT MAX(ss2.numge1500) FROM satscores ss2
) AND ss.numge1500 IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  (CASE gs.i WHEN 1 THEN s.admfname1 WHEN 2 THEN s.admfname2 WHEN 3 THEN s.admfname3 END) || ' ' ||
  (CASE gs.i WHEN 1 THEN s.admlname1 WHEN 2 THEN s.admlname2 WHEN 3 THEN s.admlname3 END) AS full_name
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
CROSS JOIN generate_series(1,3) AS gs(i)
WHERE ss.numge1500 = (
  SELECT MAX(s2.numge1500) FROM satscores s2 WHERE s2.numge1500 IS NOT NULL
)
AND (CASE gs.i WHEN 1 THEN s.admfname1 WHEN 2 THEN s.admfname2 WHEN 3 THEN s.admfname3 END) IS NOT NULL
AND (CASE gs.i WHEN 1 THEN s.admlname1 WHEN 2 THEN s.admlname2 WHEN 3 THEN s.admlname3 END) IS NOT NULL

SELECT trim(v.fullname) AS fullname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON sch.cdscode = s.cds
JOIN (SELECT max(numge1500) AS m FROM satscores) maxv ON s.numge1500 = maxv.m
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    (sch.admfname1 || ' ' || sch.admlname1),
    (sch.admfname2 || ' ' || sch.admlname2),
    (sch.admfname3 || ' ' || sch.admlname3)
) v(fullname)
WHERE v.fullname IS NOT NULL AND trim(v.fullname) <> ''

SELECT trim(a.first || ' ' || a.last) AS fullname
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = t.cds,
LATERAL (VALUES (s.admfname1, s.admlname1), (s.admfname2, s.admlname2), (s.admfname3, s.admlname3)) AS a(first, last)
WHERE t.numge1500 = (SELECT max(numge1500) FROM satscores)
AND a.first IS NOT NULL AND a.last IS NOT NULL

FROM satscores s

  AND sch.admfname1 IS NOT NULL AND sch.admlname1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT (sch.admfname2 || ' ' || sch.admlname2) AS full_name

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
LEFT JOIN trans t1 ON t1.account_id = a.account_id AND t1.date::timestamptz = '1993-03-22'::timestamptz
LEFT JOIN trans t2 ON t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.date::timestamptz = '1998-12-27'::timestamptz
WHERE l.date::timestamptz = '1993-07-05'::timestamptz
  AND l.loan_id = (
    SELECT MIN(l2.loan_id) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.date::timestamptz = '1993-07-05'::timestamptz
  )

  SELECT l.account_id
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.date = DATE '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY l.loan_id
  LIMIT 1
), target_account AS (
  SELECT d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN first_loan fl ON d.account_id = fl.account_id
  LIMIT 1
), balance_start AS (
  SELECT t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN target_account ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
  WHERE t.date = DATE '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY t.trans_id
  LIMIT 1
), balance_end AS (
  SELECT t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN target_account ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
  WHERE t.date = DATE '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY t.trans_id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance)::numeric / NULLIF(balance_start.balance, 0) * 100) AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end

WITH target_loan AS (
  SELECT l.account_id
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.date = DATE '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY l.loan_id
  LIMIT 1
), owner_disp AS (
  SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN target_loan tl ON d.account_id = tl.account_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
), balances AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT t1.balance
     FROM trans t1
     WHERE t1.account_id = od.account_id
       AND t1.date = DATE '1993-03-22'
     ORDER BY t1.trans_id DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS bal_start,
    (SELECT t2.balance
     FROM trans t2
     WHERE t2.account_id = od.account_id
       AND t2.date = DATE '1998-12-27'
     ORDER BY t2.trans_id DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS bal_end
  FROM owner_disp od
)
SELECT ((b.bal_end - b.bal_start)::numeric / NULLIF(b.bal_start, 0) * 100) AS increase_rate_percent
FROM balances b

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l.date = DATE '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
), balances AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = DATE '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) AS bal_start,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = DATE '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) AS bal_end
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN target_loan AS tl ON t.account_id = tl.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT ((bal_end - bal_start)::numeric / bal_start) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM balances

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l.date::timestamptz = DATE '1993-07-05'::timestamptz
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
owner_disp AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN target_loan AS tl ON d.account_id = tl.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
balances AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date::timestamptz = DATE '1993-03-22'::timestamptz THEN t.balance END) AS bal_start,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date::timestamptz = DATE '1998-12-27'::timestamptz THEN t.balance END) AS bal_end
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN owner_disp AS od ON t.account_id = od.account_id
)
SELECT
    ((b.bal_end - b.bal_start)::numeric / NULLIF(b.bal_start, 0) * 100) AS increase_rate
FROM balances AS b

WITH target_account AS (
  SELECT l.account_id
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.date = DATE '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY l.loan_id
  LIMIT 1
),
bal_start AS (
  SELECT t.balance AS bal
  FROM target_account ta
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
  WHERE t.date = DATE '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
bal_end AS (
  SELECT t.balance AS bal
  FROM target_account ta
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
  WHERE t.date = DATE '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((bs.bal - be.bal)::numeric / NULLIF(be.bal, 0)) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM bal_start bs, bal_end be

WITH first_loan AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE date = DATE '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY loan_id
  LIMIT 1
),
start_balance AS (
  SELECT balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan)
    AND date = DATE '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY trans_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
end_balance AS (
  SELECT balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan)
    AND date = DATE '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY trans_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ((end_balance.balance - start_balance.balance)::numeric / NULLIF(start_balance.balance, 0)) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM start_balance, end_balance

WITH first_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_before AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN first_loan fl ON t.account_id = fl.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_after AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN first_loan fl ON t.account_id = fl.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((bal_after.balance - bal_before.balance)::numeric / bal_before.balance) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM bal_before, bal_after

WITH first_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = DATE '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_a AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan)
      AND date <= DATE '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_b AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan)
      AND date <= DATE '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((SELECT balance FROM balance_a) - (SELECT balance FROM balance_b)) * 100.0
       / (SELECT balance FROM balance_b) AS increase_rate

WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    LIMIT 1
),
client_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN first_loan_client flc ON d.client_id = flc.client_id
),
balance_at_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t1 
         WHERE t1.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)
         AND t1.date = '1993-03-22' 
         ORDER BY t1.trans_id DESC 
         LIMIT 1) as balance_1993_03_22,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t2 
         WHERE t2.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)
         AND t2.date = '1998-12-27' 
         ORDER BY t2.trans_id DESC 
         LIMIT 1) as balance_1998_12_27
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN balance_1993_03_22 IS NOT NULL AND balance_1998_12_27 IS NOT NULL AND balance_1993_03_22 != 0
        THEN ((balance_1998_12_27 - balance_1993_03_22) * 100.0 / balance_1993_03_22)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS increase_rate
FROM balance_at_dates

WITH first_approved_client AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    AND l.status = 'A'
    LIMIT 1
),
client_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN first_approved_client fac ON d.client_id = fac.client_id
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t1
         JOIN client_accounts ca ON t1.account_id = ca.account_id
         WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22'
         ORDER BY trans_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS initial_balance,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t2
         JOIN client_accounts ca ON t2.account_id = ca.account_id
         WHERE t2.date = '1998-12-27'
         ORDER BY trans_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS final_balance
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN initial_balance IS NOT NULL AND final_balance IS NOT NULL AND initial_balance != 0
        THEN ((final_balance - initial_balance) * 100.0 / initial_balance)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS increase_rate
FROM balances

WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    LIMIT 1
),
client_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN first_loan_client flc ON d.client_id = flc.client_id
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t1 
         JOIN client_accounts ca ON t1.account_id = ca.account_id
         WHERE t1.date = '1998-12-27'
         ORDER BY t1.trans_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS final_balance,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t2 
         JOIN client_accounts ca ON t2.account_id = ca.account_id
         WHERE t2.date = '1993-03-22'
         ORDER BY t2.trans_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS initial_balance
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN initial_balance > 0 THEN ((final_balance - initial_balance) * 100.0 / initial_balance)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS increase_rate
FROM balances

WITH lc AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = DATE '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT t.balance
         FROM trans t
         JOIN lc ON t.account_id = lc.account_id
         WHERE t.date = DATE '1998-12-27'
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_a,
        (SELECT t.balance
         FROM trans t
         JOIN lc ON t.account_id = lc.account_id
         WHERE t.date = DATE '1993-03-22'
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_b
)
SELECT (balance_a - balance_b) * 100.0 / balance_b AS increase_rate
FROM bal

WITH first_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN first_loan f ON f.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN first_loan f ON f.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance) * 100.0 / balance_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end

WITH tgt AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = DATE '1993-07-05'
      AND l.status = 'A'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_start AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM tgt)
      AND date = DATE '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_end AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM tgt)
      AND date = DATE '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (bal_end.balance - bal_start.balance) * 100.0 / bal_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM bal_start, bal_end

questions.question:
What is the percentage of loan amount that has been fully paid with no issue.
Hint: Loan paid with no issue means contract finished, no problems; status = 'A' means contract finished, no problems; Percentage of accounts by condition = [(total(amount) & condition) / (total amount)] * 100%

candidates.sql:
SELECT (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount END)::numeric, 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount)::numeric, 0) * 100) AS pct_paid_no_issue
FROM loan l

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount),0)::numeric) * 100 AS percentage
FROM loan l

SELECT (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount END), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount), 0) * 100) AS percent_paid_no_issue
FROM loan l

SELECT (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount END), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0), 0)::numeric) * 100 AS pct_amount_paid_no_issue
FROM loan l

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount),0)::numeric) * 100 AS percent_paid_no_issue
FROM loan l

SELECT (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount END),0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount),0) * 100) AS percentage
FROM loan l

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(l.amount) = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / SUM(l.amount) * 100 
    END AS percentage_fully_paid
FROM loan AS l
SELECT (COALESCE(SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'A'), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount), 0)::numeric) * 100 AS percentage FROM loan l
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount), 0) * 100) AS percentage_paid FROM loan AS l
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(l.amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(l.amount) END AS percentage_fully_paid FROM loan AS l
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount), 0)::numeric) * 100 AS percentage FROM loan AS l

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(l.amount) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount), 0)) * 100
    END AS paid_full_percentage
FROM loan AS l

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0)) AS percentage
FROM loan

SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'A')::numeric
     / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0)) * 100,
    2
  ) AS percentage_fully_paid_no_issue
FROM loan

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / SUM(amount)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM loan

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount))
    END AS percentage
FROM loan
WHERE status = 'A' OR status = 'B' OR status = 'C' OR status = 'D'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CAST(amount AS FLOAT)) = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN CAST(amount AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CAST(amount AS FLOAT))) * 100 
    END AS percentage_paid_with_no_issue
FROM loan

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(amount) > 0 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount))
        ELSE 0 
    END AS percentage_paid_with_no_issue
FROM loan

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS paid_no_issue_percentage
FROM loan

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount), 2) AS pct_paid_no_issue
FROM loan

questions.question:
For loan amount less than USD100,000, what is the percentage of accounts that is still running with no issue.
Hint: Status = 'C' stands for running contract, ok so far; Percentage of accounts by condition = [(total(amount) & condition) / (total amount)] * 100.

candidates.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ln.status = 'C' THEN ln.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(ln.amount), 0) AS percentage_running
FROM loan AS ln
WHERE ln.amount < 100000

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount)::numeric, 0) AS percentage
FROM loan AS l
WHERE l.amount < 100000

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(l.amount) AS percentage
FROM loan AS l
WHERE l.amount < 100000

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'C' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(loan.amount), 0)::numeric) * 100 AS running_percentage
FROM loan AS loan
WHERE loan.amount < 100000

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount), 0) * 100) AS percentage
FROM loan AS l
WHERE l.amount < 100000
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN l.account_id END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id), 0) * 100) AS running_percentage FROM loan AS l WHERE l.amount < 100000

SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS percentage
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT
  SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'C') * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS percentage
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS percentage
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 AND l.status = 'C' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
              SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    END AS percentage
FROM loan l
WHERE l.amount < 100000

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(
            (SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 AND l.status = 'C' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),
            2
        )
    END AS percentage
FROM loan l
WHERE l.amount < 100000

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 AND l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount < 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
    END AS percentage
FROM loan l
WHERE l.amount < 100000

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_running_ok
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN account_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS percentage_running_ok
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN account_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS percentage
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000

questions.question:
For loans contracts which are still running where client are in debt, state their district percentage unemployment rate increment from year 1995 to 1996.
Hint: Unemployment increment rate in percentage = [(unemployment rate 1996 - unemployment rate 1995) / unemployment rate 1995] * 100; unemployment rate 1995 appears in the A12; unemployment rate 1996 appears in the A13; Loan contracts which are still running where client are in debt can be presented as status = 'D'

candidates.sql:
SELECT l.loan_id, d.district_id, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_percent
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp AS dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D' AND d.a12 IS NOT NULL AND d.a13 IS NOT NULL

SELECT l.loan_id, d.district_id, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp AS dis ON dis.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON dis.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'
  AND d.a12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.a12 <> 0

SELECT l.loan_id, d.district_id, d.a2, ((d.a13::double precision - d.a12::double precision) / NULLIF(d.a12::double precision, 0)) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT l.loan_id, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_percent
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp AS p ON a.account_id = p.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON p.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT l.loan_id, d.district_id, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D' AND d.a12 IS NOT NULL AND d.a13 IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT dist.district_id, ((dist.a13 - dist.a12) / NULLIF(dist.a12, 0)) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account acc ON l.account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id,
       ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp AS dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D' AND d.a12 <> 0

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_percent
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT d.district_id, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id,
       ((d.a13 - d.a12) / NULLIF(d.a12, 0)) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT l.loan_id,
       d.district_id,
       ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT DISTINCT d.a2, ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.district_id,
    d.a2,
    ((d.a13 - d.a12) / NULLIF(d.a12, 0)) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l

   / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date::timestamptz)=1996 THEN l.amount END),0),0)

JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id

questions.question:
What percentage of male clients request for weekly statements to be issued?
Hint: Percentage of male clients = [count(male clients who requested weekly statements / count(clients who requested weekly statements)] * 100%; Male means gender = 'M'; 'POPLATEK TYDNE' stands for weekly issuance

candidates.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 0) AS percentage_male
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)=0 THEN 0 ELSE (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)::numeric) * 100 END AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') / COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) END AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT CASE WHEN t.cnt_total = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (t.cnt_male::numeric / t.cnt_total) * 100 END AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') AS cnt_male,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS cnt_total
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
) t

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FILTER (WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE') = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FILTER (WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND c.gender = 'M') / COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FILTER (WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE') END AS percentage
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT CASE WHEN t.den = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (t.male::numeric / t.den) * 100 END AS percentage

  SELECT
    count(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') AS male,
    count(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS den
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

  count(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'i') AS iodine_count,
  count(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 's') AS sulfur_count
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b
  ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

       COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 's') AS sulfur_count

questions.question:
What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?
Hint: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; contain fluorine refers to element = 'f'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'f') * 100, COUNT(molecule_id)) where label = '+'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;

candidates.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND lower(a.element) = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id), 0) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT (CASE WHEN t.tot = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * t.without_f::numeric / t.tot END) AS percentage_not_containing_f FROM (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m1.molecule_id) FROM molecule m1 WHERE m1.label = '+') AS tot, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m2.molecule_id) FROM molecule m2 WHERE m2.label = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a2 WHERE a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id AND a2.element = 'f')) AS without_f) t

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t.has_f THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(t.molecule_id), 0) AS percentage_without_f
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         BOOL_OR(a.element = 'f') AS has_f
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) t

SELECT ((sub.total - sub.with_f) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sub.total, 0)) AS percentage_not_f
FROM (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m1.molecule_id) FROM molecule m1 WHERE m1.label = '+') AS total,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.molecule_id) FROM atom a1 JOIN molecule m2 ON a1.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id WHERE a1.element = 'f' AND m2.label = '+') AS with_f
) sub

  SELECT m.molecule_id,

  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id

Hint: tagged as  'humor' refers to tag = '<humor>'; comment of the post refers to Text; average view count = AVG(ViewCount)

SELECT p.title, c.text, AVG(p.viewcount) OVER () AS avg_viewcount
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.postid = p.id
WHERE p.tags = '<humor>'

questions.question:
What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?
Hint: student badges refers to badge's name = 'Student'; during 2010 refers to Year(Date) = 2010; during 2011 refers to Year(Date) = 2011; percentage difference = Subtract (Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2010), Count (Name)) *100, Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2011), Count(Name)) * 100)

candidates.sql:
SELECT ((t.c2010::numeric / NULLIF(t.total,0)) * 100 - (t.c2011::numeric / NULLIF(t.total,0)) * 100) AS percentage_difference
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student' AND b.date::timestamptz >= '2010-01-01'::timestamptz AND b.date::timestamptz < '2011-01-01'::timestamptz) AS c2010,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student' AND b.date::timestamptz >= '2011-01-01'::timestamptz AND b.date::timestamptz < '2012-01-01'::timestamptz) AS c2011,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student') AS total
  FROM badges b
) t

SELECT ((SUM(CASE WHEN date_part('year', b.date::timestamptz) = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100) - (SUM(CASE WHEN date_part('year', b.date::timestamptz) = 2011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100)) AS percentage_difference
FROM badges b
WHERE b.name = 'Student'

SELECT ((count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student' AND date_part('year', b.date::timestamptz) = 2010)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student'),0) * 100) - (count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student' AND date_part('year', b.date::timestamptz) = 2011)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student'),0) * 100)) AS percentage_difference
FROM badges b

SELECT ((COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN date_part('year', b.date::timestamptz) = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(b.id),0) * 100) - (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN date_part('year', b.date::timestamptz) = 2011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(b.id),0) * 100)) AS percentage_difference

Hint: DIVIDE(COUNT(PostId WHERE TagName = 'r')), (COUNT(PostId WHERE DisplayName = 'Community')) as percentage; R language refers to tagname = 'r'

candidates.sql:
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric * 100) / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::numeric, 0) AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.ownerdisplayname = 'Community'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::numeric, 0) AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.ownerdisplayname = 'Community'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100) AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.ownerdisplayname = 'Community'

SELECT 100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.tags LIKE '%<r>%')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.ownerdisplayname = 'Community'), 0) AS percentage
FROM posts p

SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN p.tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric) * 100 AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.ownerdisplayname = 'Community'

SELECT (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.id), 0)) AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.ownerdisplayname = 'Community'
SELECT (100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'

SELECT (COUNT(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(p.id), 0) * 100) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_cnt = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (r_cnt::numeric / total_cnt) * 100
    END AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(p.id) AS total_cnt,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 END) AS r_cnt
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
    WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'
) sub
SELECT (100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'

SELECT 
    (100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%'))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.id = p.owneruserid
WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_cnt = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (r_cnt::numeric / total_cnt) * 100
    END AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(p.id) AS total_cnt,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p.tags ILIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 END) AS r_cnt
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
    WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'
) sub

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.tags LIKE '%<r>%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tags LIKE '%<r>%')) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage
FROM posts

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.tags LIKE '%<r>%') * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM posts p

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN u.displayname = 'Community' THEN p.id END) = 0 
        THEN 0 
        ELSE 
            (COUNT(CASE WHEN u.displayname = 'Community' AND p.tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN p.id END) * 100.0 / 
             COUNT(CASE WHEN u.displayname = 'Community' THEN p.id END))
    END AS percentage
FROM posts p

questions.question:
Which is the most valuable post in 2010? Please give its id and the owner's display name.
Hint: the most valuable post in 2010 refers to MAX(FavoriteCount) where year(CreationDate) = 2010;

candidates.sql:
SELECT p.id, u.displayname
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM p.creaiondate::timestamptz) = 2010
  AND p.favoritecount = (
    SELECT MAX(p2.favoritecount)
    FROM posts p2
    WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM p2.creaiondate::timestamptz) = 2010
  )

SELECT p.id, u.displayname
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE p.creaiondate::timestamptz >= '2010-01-01'::timestamptz
  AND p.creaiondate::timestamptz < '2011-01-01'::timestamptz

    SELECT max(coalesce(p2.favoritecount, 0))

FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.score > 50) AS high,
         COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
  WHERE u.reputation = (SELECT MAX(u2.reputation) FROM users u2)
) s

questions.question:
Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
Hint: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT UserId where UpVotes = 0 and Score BETWEEN 5 and 10))*100, (COUNT(DISTINCT UserId where Score BETWEEN 5 and 10));

candidates.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN t.denom = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (t.num::numeric / t.denom::numeric) * 100 END AS percentage FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.userid) FILTER (WHERE u.upvotes = 0) AS num, COUNT(DISTINCT c.userid) AS denom FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE c.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10) t

SELECT CASE WHEN t.den = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (t.num::numeric / t.den) * 100 END AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c1.userid) FROM comments c1 JOIN users u1 ON c1.userid = u1.id WHERE c1.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND u1.upvotes = 0) AS num,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.userid) FROM comments c2 WHERE c2.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10) AS den
) t

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.upvotes = 0 THEN c.userid END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.userid),0)::numeric)*100 AS percentage
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.userid = u.id
WHERE c.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.userid)

     WHERE c.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND u.upvotes = 0) AS num,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.userid)

questions.question:
Which publisher created more superheroes: DC or Marvel Comics? Find the difference in the number of superheroes.
Hint: DC refers to publisher_name = 'DC Comics'; Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; difference = SUBTRACT(SUM(publisher_name = 'DC Comics'), SUM(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'));

candidates.sql:
SELECT SUM((p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics')::int) - SUM((p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')::int) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT (COALESCE(SUM((p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics')::int),0) - COALESCE(SUM((p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')::int),0)) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT (dc.c - mv.c) AS difference
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS c
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC'
) dc,
(
  SELECT COUNT(s2.id) AS c
  FROM superhero s2
  JOIN publisher p2 ON s2.publisher_id = p2.id
  WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
) mv

SELECT (COUNT(s.id) FILTER (WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) - (COUNT(s.id) FILTER (WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS difference
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics','Marvel Comics')

       SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference

questions.question:
Name the driver with the most winning. Mention his nationality and what is his maximum point scores.
Hint: Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; the most winning refers to MAX(COUNT(wins)); average point scores refers to MAX(points);

candidates.sql:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullname, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
FROM driverstandings ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ds.wins, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT (d.forename || ' ' || d.surname) AS fullname, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
FROM drivers d
JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ds.wins, 0)) = (
  SELECT MAX(total_wins) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(COALESCE(wins, 0)) AS total_wins
    FROM driverstandings
    GROUP BY driverid
  ) t
)

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullname, d.nationality, ds_stats.max_points
FROM drivers d
JOIN (
  SELECT ds.driverid, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
  FROM driverstandings ds
  GROUP BY ds.driverid
) ds_stats ON ds_stats.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE ds_stats.total_wins = (
  SELECT MAX(sub.total_wins) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ds2.wins) AS total_wins FROM driverstandings ds2 GROUP BY ds2.driverid
  ) sub
)

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullname, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
FROM drivers d
JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ds.wins > 0) = (
  SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ds2.wins > 0) AS win_count
    FROM driverstandings ds2
    GROUP BY ds2.driverid
  ) sub
)

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
FROM driverstandings ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid
GROUP BY d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
ORDER BY SUM(ds.wins) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullname, d.nationality, ds_agg.max_points
FROM drivers d
JOIN (
  SELECT ds.driverid, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
  FROM driverstandings ds
  GROUP BY ds.driverid
) ds_agg ON ds_agg.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE ds_agg.total_wins = (
  SELECT MAX(sub.sum_wins) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(wins) AS sum_wins FROM driverstandings GROUP BY driverid
  ) sub
)

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, d.nationality, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
FROM driverstandings AS ds
JOIN drivers AS d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
ORDER BY total_wins DESC, max_points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, d.nationality, ds.max_points
FROM (
    SELECT driverid, SUM(wins) AS total_wins, MAX(points) AS max_points
    FROM driverstandings
    GROUP BY driverid
) ds
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = ds.driverid
WHERE ds.total_wins = (
    SELECT MAX(t.total_wins)
    FROM (
        SELECT driverid, SUM(wins) AS total_wins
        FROM driverstandings
        GROUP BY driverid
    ) t
)

    SELECT ds.driverid,
           SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins,
           MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
    FROM driverstandings ds
    GROUP BY ds.driverid
)

       d.surname,
       d.nationality,
       agg.max_points

    JOIN aussie_1988 r ON res.raceid = r.raceid
    WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL 
    AND res.position IN (1, (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceid = r.raceid))
)
SELECT 
    CAST(((MAX(CASE WHEN is_last_driver = 1 THEN milliseconds ELSE 0 END) - 
          MAX(CASE WHEN is_champion = 1 THEN milliseconds ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0) / 
         MAX(CASE WHEN is_last_driver = 1 THEN milliseconds ELSE 1 END) AS NUMERIC(10,2)) as percentage_faster
FROM champ_and_last

WITH australian_grand_prix_1988 AS (
    SELECT raceid 
    FROM races 
    WHERE year = 1988 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion_and_last_driver_times AS (
    SELECT 
        r.driverid,
        r.time,
        r.milliseconds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.milliseconds ASC) as pos_rank
    FROM results r
    JOIN australian_grand_prix_1988 agr ON r.raceid = agr.raceid
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
champion_time AS (
    SELECT milliseconds FROM champion_and_last_driver_times WHERE pos_rank = 1
),
last_driver_time AS (
    SELECT milliseconds FROM champion_and_last_driver_times WHERE pos_rank = (
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM champion_and_last_driver_times
    )
)
SELECT 
    ((ldt.milliseconds - ct.milliseconds)::FLOAT / ldt.milliseconds::FLOAT) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM champion_time ct, last_driver_time ldt

WITH aussie_1988 AS (
    SELECT r.raceid
    FROM races r
    JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
    WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 1988
),
champion_and_last AS (
    SELECT 
        res.driverid,
        res.time,
        res.milliseconds,
        CASE WHEN res.position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_champion,
        CASE WHEN res.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceid = aussie_1988.raceid AND time IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_last
    FROM results res
    CROSS JOIN aussie_1988
    WHERE res.raceid = aussie_1988.raceid AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
champion_data AS (
    SELECT milliseconds FROM champion_and_last WHERE is_champion = 1
),
last_data AS (
    SELECT milliseconds FROM champion_and_last WHERE is_last = 1
)

    ROUND(
        ((ld.milliseconds - cd.milliseconds) * 100.0 / ld.milliseconds), 
        2
    ) as percentage_faster
FROM champion_data cd, last_data ld

  SELECT (split_part(r.time, ':', 1)::numeric * 3600
        + split_part(r.time, ':', 2)::numeric * 60
        + split_part(r.time, ':', 3)::numeric) * 1000 AS champ_ms
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
  WHERE ra.year = 1988
    AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND r.positionorder = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
),
lastd AS (
  SELECT replace(r.time, '+', '') AS gap
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid

    AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL

  SELECT CASE

         END AS inc_ms
  FROM lastd
)

  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
  AND ((r.year::text || '-01-01')::timestamptz) < '1975-01-01'::timestamptz

questions.question:
List down top 3 German drivers who has the shortest average pit stop duration and were born between 1980-1985.
Hint: Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; born between 1980-1985 refers to 1980<= year(dob) <=1985; Average pitstop duration refers to Divide(SUM(duration),COUNT(duration)); shortest average refers to Min(avg(duration));

FROM drivers d
JOIN pitstops p ON p.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob::timestamptz >= '1980-01-01'::timestamptz
  AND d.dob::timestamptz < '1986-01-01'::timestamptz
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY avg_pitstop_duration_ms ASC
LIMIT 3

FROM drivers d

WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob::timestamptz >= '1980-01-01'::timestamptz
  AND d.dob::timestamptz < '1986-01-01'::timestamptz
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname

LIMIT 3

Calculate the percentage of players who prefer left foot, who were born between 1987 and 1992.
Hint: players who prefer left foot refers to preferred_foot = 'left'; percentage of players who prefer left foot = DIVIDE(MULTIPLY((SUM(preferred_foot = 'left'), 100)), COUNT(player_fifa_api_id)); born between 1987 and 1992 refers to YEAR(birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';

  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pa.player_api_id) pa.player_api_id, pa.preferred_foot

  ORDER BY pa.player_api_id, pa.date::timestamptz DESC

?
Hint: difference of the average ball control = SUBTRACT(AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'), AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye')); AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'XX XX') = SUM(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN id ELSE NULL END)

  (SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control::numeric ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END), 0))
  -
  (SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control::numeric ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END), 0))
  AS difference
FROM player p
JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

  (
    (SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control::numeric ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END),0))
    -
    (SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control::numeric ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END),0))

JOIN player_attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

questions.question:
What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?
Hint: percentage refers to DIVIDE(COUNT(height < 180 AND overall_rating > 70),COUNT(height < 180)) * 100

candidates.sql:
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN pa.max_overall > 70 THEN 1 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::numeric,0) * 100) AS percentage_under_180_with_strength_over_70
FROM player p
JOIN (
  SELECT pa."player_api_id", MAX(pa."overall_rating") AS max_overall
  FROM player_attributes pa
  WHERE pa."overall_rating" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pa."player_api_id"
) pa ON pa."player_api_id" = p."player_api_id"
WHERE p."height" < 180

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.height < 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) * 100) AS percentage
FROM player AS p
JOIN player_attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
AND pa.date = (
  SELECT MAX(pa2.date) FROM player_attributes AS pa2 WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
)

SELECT CASE WHEN t.denom = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (t.num::numeric / t.denom::numeric) * 100 END AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p1.player_api_id) FROM player p1 WHERE p1.height < 180) AS denom,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.player_api_id) FROM player p2 WHERE p2.height < 180 AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM player_attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id AND pa.overall_rating > 70
    )) AS num
) t

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pa2.overall_rating > 70) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) , 0) AS percentage
FROM player p
JOIN (
  SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
  FROM player_attributes pa
  JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date::timestamptz) AS max_date
    FROM player_attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
  ) m ON pa.player_api_id = m.player_api_id AND pa.date::timestamptz = m.max_date

questions.question:
For the patient who was born on 1959/2/18, what is the decrease rate for his/her total cholesterol from November to December in 1981?
Hint: born on 1959/2/18 refers to Birthday = '1959-02-18'; calculation = DIVISION(SUBTRACT(SUM(Birthday = '1959-02-18' and Date like '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO`), SUM(Birthday = '1959-02-18' and Date like '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO`)), SUM(Birthday = '1959-02-18' and Date like '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO`))

candidates.sql:
SELECT
  (
    SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (
      WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz
        AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz
    )
    -
    SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (
      WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-12-01'::timestamptz
        AND l.date::timestamptz < '1982-01-01'::timestamptz
    )
  )
  /
  NULLIF(
    SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (
      WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz
        AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz
    ), 0
  ) AS decrease_rate
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.birthday::timestamptz = '1959-02-18'::timestamptz

SELECT
  (COALESCE(SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE p.birthday::timestamptz = '1959-02-18'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz),0)
   -
   COALESCE(SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE p.birthday::timestamptz = '1959-02-18'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-12-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1982-01-01'::timestamptz),0)
  )
  / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE p.birthday::timestamptz = '1959-02-18'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz),0),0) AS decrease_rate
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.birthday::timestamptz = '1959-02-18'::timestamptz

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz THEN l."T-CHO" END)::numeric
   - SUM(CASE WHEN l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-12-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1982-01-01'::timestamptz THEN l."T-CHO" END)::numeric)
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz THEN l."T-CHO" END)::numeric, 0)
  AS decrease_rate
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.birthday::timestamptz = '1959-02-18'::timestamptz

SELECT
  (SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz)
   -
   SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-12-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1982-01-01'::timestamptz)
  )
  / NULLIF(SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz), 0) AS decrease_rate
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.birthday = '1959-02-18'::date

SELECT
  (SUM(l."T-CHO" FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz))
   - SUM(l."T-CHO" FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-12-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1982-01-01'::timestamptz)))
  / NULLIF(SUM(l."T-CHO" FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz)), 0)
  AS decrease_rate
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.birthday::timestamptz = '1959-02-18'::timestamptz

  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l."date"::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l."date"::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz THEN l."T-CHO" END),0) = 0
      THEN NULL
    ELSE
      (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l."date"::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l."date"::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz THEN l."T-CHO" END),0)
       - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l."date"::timestamptz >= '1981-12-01'::timestamptz AND l."date"::timestamptz < '1982-01-01'::timestamptz THEN l."T-CHO" END),0)
      )
      / COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l."date"::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz AND l."date"::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz THEN l."T-CHO" END),0)
  END AS decrease_rate
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p."birthday"::timestamptz = '1959-02-18'::timestamptz

  SELECT
    SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-11-01'::timestamptz
                           AND l.date::timestamptz < '1981-12-01'::timestamptz) AS nov_sum,
    SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= '1981-12-01'::timestamptz
                           AND l.date::timestamptz < '1982-01-01'::timestamptz) AS dec_sum
  FROM patient p

  WHERE p.birthday = DATE '1959-02-18'
) sub

SELECT CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lab.date >= DATE '1981-11-01' AND lab.date <= DATE '1981-11-30' THEN lab."T-CHO" END) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN lab.date >= DATE '1981-11-01' AND lab.date <= DATE '1981-11-30' THEN lab."T-CHO" END) -
          SUM(CASE WHEN lab.date >= DATE '1981-12-01' AND lab.date <= DATE '1981-12-31' THEN lab."T-CHO" END))
         / SUM(CASE WHEN lab.date >= DATE '1981-11-01' AND lab.date <= DATE '1981-11-30' THEN lab."T-CHO" END)
  END AS decrease_rate

JOIN patient pat ON lab.id = pat.id

        SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-12-01' AND l.date < DATE '1982-01-01' THEN l."T-CHO" END))::numeric) /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-11-01' AND l.date < DATE '1981-12-01' THEN l."T-CHO" END), 0) AS decrease_rate
FROM patient AS p
JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.birthday = DATE '1959-02-18'

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-11-01' AND l.date <= DATE '1981-11-30' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-11-01' AND l.date <= DATE '1981-11-30' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-12-01' AND l.date <= DATE '1981-12-31' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-11-01' AND l.date <= DATE '1981-11-30' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END)::numeric END AS decrease_rate
FROM laboratory l

FROM patient p

    CASE 
        WHEN sub.nov_sum = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (sub.nov_sum - sub.dec_sum)::numeric / sub.nov_sum
    END AS decrease_rate
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '1981-11-01' 
                               AND l.date::timestamptz <= TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '1981-11-30') AS nov_sum,
        SUM(l."T-CHO") FILTER (WHERE l.date::timestamptz >= TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '1981-12-01'

    FROM laboratory AS l

  / NULLIF(

      0
    ) AS decrease_rate

             SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END))::FLOAT /

questions.question:
What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
Hint: average age = DIVIDE(SUM(SUBTRACT(YEAR(NOW()), YEAR(birthday))), COUNT(ID)); male patient refers to sex = 'M'; high cholesterol refers to "T-CHO" > = 250;

candidates.sql:
SELECT AVG(DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(now()::timestamptz, p.birthday::timestamptz))) AS average_age
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'M' AND l."T-CHO" >= 250

SELECT (SUM((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now()::timestamptz) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday::timestamptz))) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id),0)) AS average_age
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'M' AND l."T-CHO" >= 250.0

SELECT AVG(sub.age) AS average_age
FROM (
  SELECT p.id, (extract(year from now()::timestamptz) - extract(year from p.birthday::timestamptz))::numeric AS age
  FROM patient p
  JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
  WHERE p.sex = 'M' AND l."T-CHO" >= 250
  GROUP BY p.id, p.birthday
) sub

SELECT AVG(sub.age) AS average_age
FROM (
  SELECT (date_part('year', now()::timestamptz) - date_part('year', p.birthday::timestamptz)) AS age
  FROM patient p
  WHERE p.sex = 'M'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l
      WHERE l.id = p.id
        AND l."T-CHO" >= 250
    )
) sub

questions.question:
For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of those with abnormal prothrombin time (PT) that are female?
Hint: older than 55 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55; abnormal prothrombin time (PT) refers to PT > = 14; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(PT > = 14 AND SEX = 'F'), SUM(PT > = 14)) * 100; female refers to sex = 'F';

candidates.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN denom.count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (num.count::numeric / denom.count::numeric) * 100 END AS percentage
FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS count
   FROM patient p
   JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
   WHERE (date_part('year', current_timestamp) - date_part('year', p.birthday::timestamptz)) > 55
     AND l.pt >= 14
     AND p.sex = 'F') num,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS count
   FROM patient p2
   JOIN laboratory l2 ON p2.id = l2.id
   WHERE (date_part('year', current_timestamp) - date_part('year', p2.birthday::timestamptz)) > 55
     AND l2.pt >= 14) denom

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.pt >= 14 AND p.sex = 'F' THEN p.id END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.pt >= 14 THEN p.id END),0) * 100) AS percentage
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE (EXTRACT(year FROM current_timestamp::timestamptz) - EXTRACT(year FROM p.birthday::timestamptz)) > 55

SELECT COALESCE(((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE DATE_PART('year', age(current_timestamp::timestamptz, p.birthday::timestamptz)) > 55 AND l.pt >= 14 AND p.sex = 'F')::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) FROM patient p2 JOIN laboratory l2 ON p2.id = l2.id WHERE DATE_PART('year', age(current_timestamp::timestamptz, p2.birthday::timestamptz)) > 55 AND l2.pt >= 14), 0)::numeric * 100, 0) AS percentage

  SELECT p.id, p.sex

  WHERE date_part('year', age(current_timestamp::timestamptz, p.birthday::timestamptz)) > 55

JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id

questions.question:
In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?
Hint: Year 2012 can be presented as Between 201201 And 201212; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.

candidates.sql:
SELECT t.customerid
FROM (
  SELECT c.customerid,
         SUM(ym.consumption) AS total,
         MIN(SUM(ym.consumption)) OVER () AS mn
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
  WHERE c.segment = 'LAM'
    AND ((ym.date || '01')::timestamptz BETWEEN '2012-01-01'::timestamptz AND '2012-12-31'::timestamptz)
  GROUP BY c.customerid
) t
WHERE t.total = t.mn

SELECT c.customerid, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
WHERE to_date(ym.date, 'YYYYMM')::timestamptz BETWEEN to_date('201201', 'YYYYMM')::timestamptz AND to_date('201212', 'YYYYMM')::timestamptz
  AND c.segment = 'LAM'
GROUP BY c.customerid
ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
LIMIT 1

  select c.customerid, sum(y.consumption) as total_consumption,
    min(sum(y.consumption)) over () as min_total
  from customers c

  where c.segment = 'LAM' and left(y.date,4) = '2012'

  JOIN yearmonth y
    ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.segment = 'SME'
    AND to_timestamp(y.date || '01','YYYYMMDD')::timestamptz
        BETWEEN to_timestamp('20130101','YYYYMMDD')::timestamptz
            AND to_timestamp('20131201','YYYYMMDD')::timestamptz + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day'

questions.question:
What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
Hint: annual average consumption of customer with the lowest consumption in each segment = total consumption per year / the number of customer with lowest consumption in each segment; Difference in annual average = SME's annual average - LAM's annual average; Difference in annual average = LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.

candidates.sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.customerid AS c_customerid, c.segment AS c_segment, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
  WHERE to_date(ym.date || '01','YYYYMMDD')::timestamptz BETWEEN '2013-01-01'::timestamptz AND '2013-12-31'::timestamptz
    AND c.segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
seg_min AS (
  SELECT t.c_segment AS segment, MIN(t.total) AS min_total
  FROM totals t
  GROUP BY t.c_segment
),
seg_counts AS (
  SELECT s.segment, s.min_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.total = s.min_total) AS cnt_min
  FROM seg_min s
  JOIN totals t ON t.c_segment = s.segment
  GROUP BY s.segment, s.min_total
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT sc.segment, (sc.min_total::double precision / NULLIF(sc.cnt_min,0)) AS avg_low
  FROM seg_counts sc
)
SELECT
  (COALESCE((SELECT sa.avg_low FROM seg_avg sa WHERE sa.segment = 'SME'),0)
   - COALESCE((SELECT sa.avg_low FROM seg_avg sa WHERE sa.segment = 'LAM'),0)) AS sme_minus_lam,
  (COALESCE((SELECT sa.avg_low FROM seg_avg sa WHERE sa.segment = 'LAM'),0)
   - COALESCE((SELECT sa.avg_low FROM seg_avg sa WHERE sa.segment = 'KAM'),0)) AS lam_minus_kam,
  (COALESCE((SELECT sa.avg_low FROM seg_avg sa WHERE sa.segment = 'KAM'),0)
   - COALESCE((SELECT sa.avg_low FROM seg_avg sa WHERE sa.segment = 'SME'),0)) AS kam_minus_sme

  (SELECT a.avg_consumption FROM avg_per_segment a WHERE a.segment = 'SME')

WITH cust_cons AS (
  SELECT c.segment,
         c.customerid,
         SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_cons
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym
    ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.date LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY c.segment, c.customerid
),
seg_stats AS (
  SELECT segment,
         MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons,
         SUM(total_cons) FILTER (WHERE total_cons = MIN(total_cons) OVER (PARTITION BY segment)) AS sum_min,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_cons = MIN(total_cons) OVER (PARTITION BY segment)) AS cnt_min
  FROM cust_cons
  GROUP BY segment
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT segment,
         sum_min / NULLIF(cnt_min, 0)::real AS avg_cons
  FROM seg_stats
)
SELECT 'SME_vs_LAM' AS comparison, (s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons) AS difference
FROM seg_avg s1
JOIN seg_avg s2 ON s1.segment = 'SME' AND s2.segment = 'LAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LAM_vs_KAM', (s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons)
FROM seg_avg s1
JOIN seg_avg s2 ON s1.segment = 'LAM' AND s2.segment = 'KAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'KAM_vs_SME', (s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons)
FROM seg_avg s1
JOIN seg_avg s2 ON s1.segment = 'KAM' AND s2.segment = 'SME'

WITH cust_cons AS (

  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid

    AND ym.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
min_cons AS (
  SELECT segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
  FROM cust_cons
  GROUP BY segment
),
lowest_cust AS (
  SELECT cc.segment, cc.total_cons
  FROM cust_cons cc
  JOIN min_cons mc ON cc.segment = mc.segment AND cc.total_cons = mc.min_cons
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT segment, AVG(total_cons) AS avg_cons
  FROM lowest_cust
  GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN avg_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_cons END) AS sme_lam_diff,
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_cons END) AS lam_kam_diff,
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN avg_cons END) AS kam_sme_diff
FROM seg_avg

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
  SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY customerid
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT c.segment, MIN(yc.total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearly_consumption yc ON c.customerid = yc.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
  GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE segment = 'SME') -
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS sme_lam_diff,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE segment = 'LAM') -
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS lam_kam_diff,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE segment = 'KAM') -
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE segment = 'SME') AS kam_sme_diff

WITH customer_annual AS (
    SELECT c.customerid,
           c.segment,
           SUM(y.consumption) AS annual_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT segment,

    FROM customer_annual

),
lowest_customers AS (

           ca.annual_consumption
    FROM customer_annual ca

),
segment_avg AS (

           AVG(annual_consumption) AS avg_annual
    FROM lowest_customers

)
SELECT

    (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE segment = 'SME') AS kam_sme_diff

WITH segment_consumption AS (

),
lowest_consumption_customers AS (

),
filtered_segments AS (

),
segment_differences AS (

        (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM filtered_segments WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
        (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM filtered_segments WHERE segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM filtered_segments WHERE segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff
)
SELECT * FROM segment_differences

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.segment,
        SUBSTRING(y.date FROM 1 FOR 4) AS year,

SELECT

    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM filtered_segments WHERE segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM filtered_segments WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS lam_kam_diff,
    
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM filtered_segments WHERE segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM filtered_segments WHERE segment = 'SME') AS kam_sme_diff

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.segment,
        SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ym.customerid) AS customer_count
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013'
        AND c.currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.segment, SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4)
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        segment,
        total_consumption / customer_count AS avg_annual_consumption
    FROM yearly_consumption
),
min_consumption_customers AS (

        c.segment,
        ym.customerid,
        SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013'
        AND c.currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.segment, ym.customerid
),
lowest_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM min_consumption_customers
    GROUP BY segment
),
customers_with_lowest_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        mcc.segment,
        mcc.customerid,
        mcc.total_consumption
    FROM min_consumption_customers mcc
    JOIN lowest_consumption_per_segment lcs ON mcc.segment = lcs.segment 
        AND mcc.total_consumption = lcs.min_consumption
),
avg_lowest_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) AS avg_lowest_consumption
    FROM customers_with_lowest_consumption
    GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest_consumption WHERE segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest_consumption WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS sme_lam_diff,
    (SELECT avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest_consumption WHERE segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest_consumption WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest_consumption WHERE segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest_consumption WHERE segment = 'SME') AS kam_sme_diff

WITH cons AS (
    SELECT c.segment, c.customerid, SUM(y.consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(SUBSTRING(y.date FROM 1 FOR 4) AS integer) = 2013
      AND y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.segment, c.customerid
),
mins AS (
    SELECT segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cons
    GROUP BY segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT l.segment, SUM(l.total_consumption) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM cons l
    JOIN mins m ON l.segment = m.segment AND l.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY l.segment
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT segment, total::real / cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE segment = 'SME') AS diff_kam_sme

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.segment, y.customerid, SUM(y.consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.segment, y.customerid
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_total
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT p.segment, SUM(p.total_cons) AS sum_cons, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_cons m ON m.segment = p.segment AND p.total_cons = m.min_total
    GROUP BY p.segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT segment, sum_cons / num_customers AS avg_cons
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM annual_avg WHERE segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_cons FROM annual_avg WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM annual_avg WHERE segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_cons FROM annual_avg WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM annual_avg WHERE segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_cons FROM annual_avg WHERE segment = 'SME') AS diff_kam_sme

questions.question:
Is it true that more SMEs pay in Czech koruna than in euros? If so, how many more?
Hint: Amount of more SMEs = Total of SMEs pay using Currency CZK - Total of SMEs pay using Currency EUR

candidates.sql: SELECT ((SELECT count(cz.customerid) FROM customers cz WHERE cz.segment = 'SME' AND cz.currency = 'CZK') - (SELECT count(eu.customerid) FROM customers eu WHERE eu.segment = 'SME' AND eu.currency = 'EUR')) AS difference

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' AND c.segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' AND c.segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS more_sme_pay_czk,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' AND c.segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' AND c.segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS more_sme_count
FROM customers c

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS is_more, (SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS difference
FROM customers c
WHERE c.segment = 'SME'

SELECT (t.czk_count > t.eur_count) AS is_more, (t.czk_count - t.eur_count) AS more_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'CZK') AS czk_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'EUR') AS eur_count
  FROM customers c
  WHERE c.segment = 'SME'
) t

questions.question:
For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.
Hint: August of 2012 refers to the Date value = '201208' ; Price per unit of product = Price / Amount;

candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ym.customerid, ym.consumption
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN yearmonth ym
  ON ym.customerid = t.customerid
WHERE t.productid = 5
  AND (t.price::numeric / NULLIF(t.amount,0)) > 29.00
  AND to_timestamp(ym.date, 'YYYYMM')::timestamptz = to_timestamp('201208', 'YYYYMM')::timestamptz
